subject: Under-stairs storage designed to fit
hook: Our meter is under the stairs. Can we still have fitted storage?
fb:
A question we hear a lot in Staffordshire homes: our meter is under the stairs, so can we still have fitted storage there?

Usually, yes. It is one of the first things we note during the survey, along with the consumer unit, the router and any cables. We then plan the layout around it, normally with a hinged door or a removable panel right in front of the meter so it stays easy to read and reach. The rest of the space can then be pull-outs or drawers.

The key is that we know about it before anything is designed, not on fitting day.

gbp:
Can you fit under-stairs storage if the meter is under there?

In most homes, yes. Gas and electric meters, consumer units and broadband routers are often tucked under the stairs, and they need to stay accessible. During our survey we record exactly where they are, then design the storage around them.

That usually means a hinged door or removable panel positioned in front of the meter, so readings and access are straightforward, while pull-out units or drawers make use of the rest of the space. Everything is built in our Hanley workshop and fitted by our own team, so the layout we agree is the layout you get.

We cover homes across Stoke-on-Trent and the surrounding area. Start with a free, no-obligation design consultation and an itemised quote.
